denominator_note: N_source is provisional. The final N is set only by the U-203 three-way join; no legacy 47/57 denominator was reused.

methodology.unit_rule: One atom has one trigger, one observable effect, and one independently degradable/verifiable behavior. Same source line may yield multiple atoms when effects can fail independently.
methodology.evidence_rule: Each atom carries the exact primary upstream commit/path/range plus its local adoption row and dossier; supporting upstream refs are explicit.
methodology.whole_install_rule: For install/install-refresh/install-personal rows, the installed source contract is enumerated, not merely the coarse dossier summary.
methodology.port_rule: For port/adapt rows, only the locally adopted subset is enumerated.
methodology.forbidden_input: This census did not read this cycle live-census.json, independent-census.json, atomic-manifest.yaml, or any other cycle producer output.

exclusions.scope: Current-cycle live census and producer outputs
Upstream HEAD candidates never adopted locally
exclusions.reason: Tracked in head-ledger.json, not counted in the adopted source denominator.

exclusions.scope: Prior MP-001 through MP-057 sequence IDs
exclusions.reason: They were composite/order-dependent; this census recomputes content-addressed IDs.

atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Callers and tests cross the same interface seam; tests do not reach past it.
atoms.verification: Propose an internal-state assertion and require rejection.

atoms.trigger: A description contains synonymous triggers.
atoms.observable_effect: Synonyms for one branch collapse to one trigger while distinct branches remain.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Synonyms for one branch collapse to one trigger while distinct branches remain.
atoms.verification: Duplicate one branch under synonyms and require failure.

atoms.trigger: An ADR is considered.
atoms.observable_effect: It is offered only when hard-to-reverse, surprising without context, and a real trade-off are all true.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: It is offered only when hard-to-reverse, surprising without context, and a real trade-off are all true.
atoms.verification: Remove any one predicate and require the offer to be suppressed.

atoms.trigger: One mechanical change has codebase-wide blast radius.
atoms.observable_effect: An expand ticket introduces the new form beside the old before migrations.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: An expand ticket introduces the new form beside the old before migrations.
atoms.verification: Begin by deleting the old form and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A module needs a dependency.
atoms.observable_effect: The dependency is accepted from the caller rather than constructed internally.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The dependency is accepted from the caller rather than constructed internally.
atoms.verification: Mutate to new StripeGateway inside the function and require rejection.

atoms.trigger: A workspace glossary exists.
atoms.observable_effect: Every later lesson uses its canonical vocabulary.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Every later lesson uses its canonical vocabulary.
atoms.verification: Use an avoided alias and require failure.

atoms.trigger: Expansion is available.
atoms.observable_effect: Callers migrate in blast-radius-sized batches while CI remains green.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Callers migrate in blast-radius-sized batches while CI remains green.
atoms.verification: Create one unbounded migration ticket and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A step or rule set needs a done condition.
atoms.observable_effect: The completion criterion is both checkable and appropriately exhaustive.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The completion criterion is both checkable and appropriately exhaustive.
atoms.verification: Replace it with understanding reached and require failure.

atoms.trigger: An upstream decision clears uncertainty.
atoms.observable_effect: Only now-sharp questions graduate from Not yet specified into tickets.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Only now-sharp questions graduate from Not yet specified into tickets.
atoms.verification: Pre-slice an unphraseable fog patch and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A framework/skill lifecycle behavior changes.
atoms.observable_effect: A durable changelog/history entry is created for that change.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: A durable changelog/history entry is created for that change.
atoms.verification: Make a lifecycle change with no history entry and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A huge foggy effort is mapped.
atoms.observable_effect: The destination is named before tickets because it fixes scope.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The destination is named before tickets because it fixes scope.
atoms.verification: Create tickets before a destination and require failure.

atoms.trigger: No correct regression seam exists.
atoms.observable_effect: The absence is documented as an architectural finding instead of faking coverage.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The absence is documented as an architectural finding instead of faking coverage.
atoms.verification: Force a shallow test and require failure.

atoms.trigger: The ranked hypotheses are ready.
atoms.observable_effect: They are shown to the user before testing, while AFK absence does not block progress.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: They are shown to the user before testing, while AFK absence does not block progress.
atoms.verification: Begin testing before surfacing the list and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A baseline smell is detected.
atoms.observable_effect: It is reported as a judgement call, not a hard violation.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: It is reported as a judgement call, not a hard violation.
atoms.verification: Require failure if the smell is stated as mechanically forbidden.

atoms.trigger: A handoff may contain secrets or personal data.
atoms.observable_effect: Sensitive values are replaced with an explicit redaction token before persistence.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Sensitive values are replaced with an explicit redaction token before persistence.
atoms.verification: Insert a fixture API key and require leak detection.

atoms.trigger: A regression test is considered.
atoms.observable_effect: It is written only at a seam that reproduces the real call-site bug pattern.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: It is written only at a seam that reproduces the real call-site bug pattern.
atoms.verification: Offer a shallow false-confidence seam and require rejection.

atoms.trigger: A guardrail is wired against a clean example.
atoms.observable_effect: The exact check passes on the clean fixture.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The exact check passes on the clean fixture.
atoms.verification: Run the clean fixture and require zero exit.

atoms.trigger: Reusable compressed learning material is produced.
atoms.observable_effect: A quick-reference, printable HTML artifact is stored under reference/.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: A quick-reference, printable HTML artifact is stored under reference/.
atoms.verification: Return only prose in chat and require the reference artifact.

atoms.trigger: A lesson component may be reused.
atoms.observable_effect: The component lives under assets/ and is shared across lessons.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The component lives under assets/ and is shared across lessons.
atoms.verification: Duplicate the component inline and require failure.

atoms.trigger: Claim verification completes.
atoms.observable_effect: The outcome is reported as confirmed with code path, failed, or insufficient detail.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The outcome is reported as confirmed with code path, failed, or insufficient detail.
atoms.verification: Say verified without an evidence state and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A ticket is resolved.
atoms.observable_effect: Its answer closes the ticket, adds one map pointer, and graduates or removes affected fog.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Its answer closes the ticket, adds one map pointer, and graduates or removes affected fog.
atoms.verification: Leave stale fog or duplicate detail and require failure.

atoms.trigger: The Standards axis reviews code quality.
atoms.observable_effect: A fixed high-signal Fowler smell baseline is considered even when repo docs are silent.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: A fixed high-signal Fowler smell baseline is considered even when repo docs are silent.
atoms.verification: Inject a baseline smell and require it to surface.

atoms.trigger: All markers are removed.
atoms.observable_effect: Relevant tests, type checks, and linters run.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Relevant tests, type checks, and linters run.
atoms.verification: Skip all checks and require incomplete resolution.

atoms.trigger: A skill enters a promoted/public bucket.
atoms.observable_effect: Its public top-level registry entry is present.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Its public top-level registry entry is present.
atoms.verification: Remove the public registry entry and require registration-sync failure.

atoms.trigger: Before the first test is written.
atoms.observable_effect: The proposed public seams are written down and confirmed by the user.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The proposed public seams are written down and confirmed by the user.
atoms.verification: Withhold seam confirmation and verify that no test is authored.

atoms.trigger: Alternatives have been compared.
atoms.observable_effect: A strong recommendation or justified hybrid is given, not just a menu.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: A strong recommendation or justified hybrid is given, not just a menu.
atoms.verification: Return an unranked menu and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A lesson makes factual claims.
atoms.observable_effect: Claims are backed by external citations tracked in RESOURCES.md.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Claims are backed by external citations tracked in RESOURCES.md.
atoms.verification: Remove citations and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A retention exercise is designed.
atoms.observable_effect: The learner retrieves from memory instead of merely rereading.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The learner retrieves from memory instead of merely rereading.
atoms.verification: Offer only recognition/rereading and require failure.

atoms.trigger: Evidence suggests the learner mission should change.
atoms.observable_effect: The change is confirmed with the learner before MISSION.md is edited.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The change is confirmed with the learner before MISSION.md is edited.
atoms.verification: Edit the mission without confirmation and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A learner appears fluent in the moment.
atoms.observable_effect: Lesson design still targets long-term storage strength rather than equating fluency with mastery.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Lesson design still targets long-term storage strength rather than equating fluency with mastery.
atoms.verification: Use immediate recognition as mastery evidence and require failure.

atoms.trigger: The user asks to learn a topic over multiple sessions.
atoms.observable_effect: The current directory is treated as persistent learning state across sessions.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The current directory is treated as persistent learning state across sessions.
atoms.verification: Start a later session with existing artifacts and require them to be read.

atoms.trigger: No individual migration batch can stay green.
atoms.observable_effect: Batches share an integration branch and block one final integrate-and-verify ticket.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Batches share an integration branch and block one final integrate-and-verify ticket.
atoms.verification: Promise green per impossible batch and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A test needs substitution.
atoms.observable_effect: Only system boundaries are mocked; owned internal collaborators remain real.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: Only system boundaries are mocked; owned internal collaborators remain real.
atoms.verification: Propose mocking an owned class and require rejection.

atoms.trigger: A prompt tries to steer by prohibition.
atoms.observable_effect: It states the desired positive behavior; an unavoidable guardrail is paired with that target.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: It states the desired positive behavior; an unavoidable guardrail is paired with that target.
atoms.verification: Give only a prohibition and require failure.

atoms.trigger: A new seam is proposed.
atoms.observable_effect: The seam is introduced only when at least two justified adapters vary across it.
atoms.independent_degradation: The trigger occurs, but this effect alone is absent, weakened, or contradicted: The seam is introduced only when at least two justified adapters vary across it.
atoms.verification: Offer one-adapter indirection and require rejection.
